lines.english: "Ouch!"
The next thing I felt was a sudden shock on my cheek.
"You said you absolutely would not fall asleep, yet you couldn't even hold out for 30 minutes."
"Ah, w-wha…?"
I came to my senses… though with quite the poor timing, as I see a familiar sight through the window.
"We're here. Setsuna's place."
"Ah, ah, yeah… Hey, Setsuna, wake up."
"Mm… Mm?"
I feel awkward because I couldn't keep my promise, and embarrassed because of what we were talking about before I made the promise, so I end up fumbling around like an idiot.
After waking me up, Touma opened the trunk and looked away as if to tell me it's none of her business.
"Is this all the luggage? Make sure you don't take the wrong bag of souvenirs, okay?"
"Yeah, it's fine… Kazusa didn't buy any souvenirs, after all."
"…I see."
We took out two backpacks and three paper bags from the trunk, leaving only a single backpack inside.
"All right, then… thanks for everything."
"…Sure."
I peeked inside the car that has become as lonely as the trunk has, but Touma continued to stare away somewhere else.
"Huh? You're getting off here as well, Haruki-kun? Isn't Kazusa going to drop you off at your place?"
"Eh? Ah, that's…"
"Why should I go through the trouble of doing that? He can take the train home by himself from here."
"Really…? I guess there's no helping it if you put it that way, Kazusa."
I wonder how Setsuna interpreted Touma's disgruntled response.
She couldn't have realized that Touma and I have a common interest now, could she?
"See you, then… When school starts again."
"Let's do our New Year's shrine visit together before that! I'll give you a call!"
"…Sure."
"Touma…"
"Ah…"
In the end…
Touma kept avoiding eye contact and acted coldly to me up until the very end.
"…It's over."
"Yeah."
"It's not… the three of us anymore."
"Yeah…"
It's not the three of us anymore.
Even though we were so close last night.
Enjoying ourselves, playing pranks, I'm sure that we all wished for that day to last forever.
"Feels lonely, huh…"
Even though it's only been a day, the distance between us is back to how it was before. We're down from three to two, and we'll soon be all alone.
All alone…
"What will you do? Wanna come inside for now?"
"Ah, um…"
"It's cold outside, and you must be tired. Come in and have some tea before you go, okay?"
In an attempt to brush away the loneliness, Setsuna grabs my arm and reaches for the door.
The fact that her grip is slightly tighter than usual tells me that she genuinely wants me to stay.
"No."
"Huh…?"
But that only ever so slightly tighter grip…
Awakens an irrepressible feeling within me… One which makes me think she might not be feeling nearly as lonely as I am right now.
"Wh… ah…?"
Before she could notice, I pinned Setsuna from behind…
Well, at least that's what it must seem like to her, with how forceful my embrace is.
"Haruki-kun…"
"It's cold… but it's fine here."
As I run my hands across her coat, I recall the feeling of her smooth skin that I felt from touching her back in the bath.
Smelling the fragrance from Setsuna's hair, I recall the sensation of her seductive, wet hair laying against my shoulder.
Setsuna, as if accepting the situation, drops her bags.
And in return, I excitedly touch her soft cheeks, turning her head so that it faces me…
"Mm…"
"Mm, mm…"
I cravingly put my lips against Setsuna's.
"Ah, mm… Ah, ah, um… mm? Ha, ah, mm… Haa…!"
I press my lips against hers, open her lips with my tongue, and lick around the inside of her mouth.
"Ha, ahh… Haru…ki… Mm!? Ha, ahh, ahh… Mmm…!"
Still unsatisfied, I entwine my tongue with hers and move deeper inside her mouth…
"Mmm… Mm, ahmm!? Ah, haa, haaa…!"
My hand that was touching her back shifts forward, reaching into her coat and touching her breasts…
"Ha, ah, wait, Haruki-kun, w-wait… Hey…!"
Setsuna desperately stops me, and I finally regain my composure.
In that instant, I finally realize what I've been doing.
"Sorry…"
Setsuna wipes her wet lips with her fingers and fixes the disheveled lapel of her coat.
I realize that something must be wrong with me after causing this unpleasant scene without even the slightest consideration for her.
"Do you… really want to touch me that much?"
"I want to carve it all into me. The sensation of touching you, Setsuna…"
"Haruki-kun…"
What's moreーI'm shamelessly forcing myself onto her like this… I must be completely out of my mind today.
"For some reason, I just… I can't hold myself back right now."
"Why?"
Am I compensating for not being able to be alone with her for the past two days?
No…
"I don't know. I don't know, but…"
It's because the three of us were together for the past two days, and I'm reacting terribly to losing one.
And… I'm so scared of being all alone again.
"I see…"
Who's the lonely one here, and who should I be missing? Though I've already come to a rational conclusion on that, I can't understand everything else that's going on inside me at all.
"If you don't know, then there's no helping that, is there?"
"Setsuna…?"
"Then… feel free to touch, okay? But we're outside, so do it through my clothes…"
"…! Setsuna!"
"Ah, mm… Mm… Haa, ah…"
That's why a part of me separate from my rational self reacted immediately the moment Setsuna gave me her consent.
I forcefully open Setsuna's lips again and grope her through her cardigan, committing every ounce of the sensation of her body to memory.
"Ha, ha… Ah… Ah, haa… hnn…!"
As I frantically thrust my tongue to touch Setsuna's, she finally starts to timidly move her tongue along with mine.
She slowly relaxes her entire body, taking in the movement of my hand along her soft breasts.
"Ahh, ah… Mmm, ha… Mmh… Aahh…!"
I waste no time to feel moved by how gentle Setsuna's being and indulge in her body even more passionately.
"Haa, ah, mn, fua… Haa, ahh… Mmm… Hey… Haruki-kun…!"
To make sure that I don't think of anyone but Setsuna tonight.
"Hey, what should I do? Ever since I started dating you, Haruki-kun… I've been gradually becoming a bad girl…"
Setsuna's lips, Setsuna's tongue, Setsuna's mouth, Setsuna's softness, Setsuna's seductiveness… Those are the only things coursing through my body as I writhe in ecstasy.
"…If it's for you, Haruki-kun, I feel like I could become even more of a bad girl, you know?"
"Setsuna…!"
